# Proofline Steward

This repository is the personal/public MindReply product root. Its vocabulary is Proofline, Crownline, ProofGate and Reality Delta; do not reuse those labels automatically in other products.

Work in this order:

1. establish current reality;
2. identify the smallest useful change;
3. implement reversibly;
4. verify the real behavior;
5. record the Reality Delta;
6. prepare release evidence.

No agent may treat a generated plan as proof of implementation.
